title: Nutty Turkish Anchovy Casserole
description: A savory, nutty casserole featuring anchovy fillets and a pistachio crust, baked in a traditional Turkish earthenware pot.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi over medium heat until it is hot.
Pat the anchovy fillets dry and place them in the hot pot, letting them sear for 2 minutes.
Add the minced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, sumac, oregano, lemon zest, and a pinch of salt, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in the olive oil and let the mixture simmer for 2 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
In a bowl, combine the chopped pistachios, walnuts, and parsley, seasoning lightly with salt.
Spread the nut mixture evenly over the anchovy base in the pot.
Cover the pot with the lid and reduce the heat to low, simmering for 20 minutes.
Rotate the pot occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Remove the lid, let the casserole rest for 5 minutes, then serve hot.
